scene.label: Act 5, Scene 3
scene.title: SCENE III. The temple of Diana at Ephesus; Thaisa standing near the altar, as high priestess; a number of Virgins on each side; Cerimon and other inhabitants of Ephesus attending.
scene.location: The temple of Diana at Ephesus; Thaisa standing near the altar, as high priestess; a number of Virgins on each side; Cerimon and other inhabitants of Ephesus attending.

content.text: Enter Pericles with his train; Lysimachus, Helicanus, Marina and a Lady.

lines.text: Hail, Dian! to perform thy just command,
lines.plainText: Hail Dian to perform thy just command

lines.text: I here confess myself the King of Tyre;
lines.plainText: I here confess myself the King of Tyre

lines.text: Who, frighted from my country, did wed
lines.plainText: Who frighted from my country did wed

lines.text: At Pentapolis the fair Thaisa.
lines.plainText: At Pentapolis the fair Thaisa

lines.plainText: At sea in childbed died she but brought forth

lines.text: Wears yet thy silver livery. She at Tarsus
lines.plainText: Wears yet thy silver livery She at Tarsus

lines.plainText: Was nursed with Cleon who at fourteen years

lines.plainText: I threw her overboard with these very arms

lines.text: Upon this coast, I warrant you.
lines.plainText: Upon this coast I warrant you

lines.text: 'Tis most certain.
lines.plainText: 'Tis most certain

lines.plainText: Whither I invite you Look Thaisa is

lines.text: Recovered.

lines.text: O, let me look!
lines.plainText: O let me look

lines.plainText: If he be none of mine my sanctity

lines.plainText: Will to my sense bend no licentious ear

lines.text: Are you not Pericles? Like him you spake,

lines.plainText: The voice of dead Thaisa

lines.text: And drown'd.
lines.plainText: And drown'd

lines.text: Now I know you better,
lines.plainText: Now I know you better

lines.text: When we with tears parted Pentapolis,
lines.plainText: When we with tears parted Pentapolis

lines.plainText: The king my father gave you such a ring

lines.text: This, this: no more, you gods! your present kindness

lines.plainText: Makes my past miseries sports you shall do well

lines.plainText: A second time within these arms

lines.plainText: Hail madam and my queen

lines.plainText: I know you not

lines.plainText: The gods can have no mortal officer

lines.plainText: How this dead queen relives

lines.plainText: I will my lord

lines.text: How she came placed here in the temple;
lines.plainText: How she came placed here in the temple

lines.plainText: Will offer nightoblations to thee Thaisa

lines.text: This prince, the fair betrothed of your daughter,
lines.plainText: This prince the fair betrothed of your daughter

lines.text: Shall marry her at Pentapolis.
lines.plainText: Shall marry her at Pentapolis

lines.text: And now this ornament
lines.plainText: And now this ornament

lines.plainText: Makes me look dismal will I clip to form

lines.plainText: And what this fourteen years no razor touch'd

lines.plainText: To grace thy marriageday I'll beautify

lines.text: My father's dead.
lines.plainText: My father's dead

lines.plainText: Heavens make a star of him Yet there my queen

lines.text: We'll celebrate their nuptials, and ourselves
lines.plainText: We'll celebrate their nuptials and ourselves

lines.text: Will in that kingdom spend our following days:
lines.plainText: Will in that kingdom spend our following days

lines.plainText: Our son and daughter shall in Tyrus reign

lines.plainText: To hear the rest untold Sir lead's the way

lines.plainText: In Antiochus and his daughter you have heard

lines.plainText: In Pericles his queen and daughter seen

lines.plainText: Although assail'd with Fortune fierce and keen

lines.plainText: Virtue preserved from fell destruction's blast

lines.plainText: Led on by heaven and crown'd with joy at last

lines.plainText: In Helicanus may you well descry
